meta.name: Walking on Thin Ice
meta.description: Eun-soo is a housewife, who struggles to pay for her husband's medical expenses. He is terminally ill. Eun-soo becomes entangled in a bag of drugs with a teacher named Yi-kyeong. He is a mysterious figure. Eun-soo and Yi-kyeong are chased by veteran detective Tae-gu.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: An ordinary housewife, Eun Soo, steps into the world of drugs and finds herself in her life's biggest crisis.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A dangerous partnership forms as Eun Soo and Kyung sell drugs to VIPs while the police close in on them.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: James becomes furious after finding out the source of the drugs Eun Soo brought and tells her to give them up.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Eun Soo tries to earn 100,000 dollars in two weeks and decides to meet a buyer face-to-face, alone.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: When a burner phone links Eun Soo to a missing dealer, she must outwit the sharp detectives closing in.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Eun Soo is stunned to learn her attacker is a coworker, but her captives soon vanish into the night.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Forced to pay a blackmailer, Eun Soo and Kyung resume their risky operation while hunting the suspect.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The blackmailer is a corrupt cop who forces Lee Kyung to use his partner Eun Soo to secretly pay him off.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A detective is framed by his boss, who now targets a desperate mother's daughter to gain control.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Blackmailed by Tae Gu and exposed to Do Jin, Eun Soo considers a dangerous offer to save her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: As his own protege closes in, corrupt detective Jang Tae Gu finds his entire empire of lies crumbling.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A desperate mother cuts a dangerous deal with police, agreeing to lure her husband's killer into a trap.
